recognize_zh: 腦部 MRI 有周圍水腫的環狀病灶、胸部 CT 有肺部實質化與肋膜積液，組織切片見混合發炎細胞中淡棕色的分隔菌絲；玻片培養（lactophenol cotton blue）見分隔菌絲與雙細胞棒狀分生孢子，培養皿為深橄欖褐色菌落並釋出紅褐色色素，符合嗜熱暗色真菌 Verruconis gallopava 感染。
features: MRI brain T2 (A): left parietal ring-like lesion with a hypointense rim and surrounding vasogenic edema
MRI spine (B) and CT chest (C): additional lesions, with lung consolidation/effusion on CT
Tissue H&E (D): mixed inflammatory infiltrate with histiocytes and neutrophils and faintly pigmented, septate hyphal fragments
Lactophenol cotton blue mount (E): thin septate hyphae bearing clavate to cylindrical two-celled conidia
Culture plate (F): dark olive-brown to black velvety colonies with a red-brown diffusible pigment in the agar
describe_en: Composite figure. Brain MRI shows a ring-like parietal lesion with surrounding edema, and spine MRI and chest CT show additional sites of disease including pulmonary consolidation. Tissue biopsy shows a mixed inflammatory infiltrate containing faintly pigmented septate hyphal elements. The lactophenol cotton blue mount from culture shows septate hyphae with clavate two-celled conidia, and the culture plate grows dark olive-brown colonies producing a reddish-brown diffusible pigment. Findings are consistent with disseminated phaeohyphomycosis due to Verruconis gallopava in an immunosuppressed patient with myelofibrosis on ruxolitinib.

ddx.vs: Aspergillus hyphae are hyaline with acute-angle branching and form conidial heads with phialides, not pigmented hyphae with two-celled clavate conidia.
Mucorales have broad, ribbon-like pauciseptate hyphae with right-angle branching and non-pigmented colonies.
These produce chains of one-celled conidia or annellides, whereas Verruconis is thermotolerant with two-celled conidia and a red-brown diffusible pigment; sequencing confirms.
Nocardia forms thin beaded branching filaments that are modified acid-fast and grow as chalky white bacterial colonies.

stain: MRI/CT; H&E; lactophenol cotton blue; culture
